name: Sultanahmet Camii
source: Built for the Istanbul 3D map (Groker, 4 Nov 2026) from the OSM outline r18055570 and building:parts (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL); figures from landmarks_sources.md §2/§16 ([B1] DİA, [B2] Kültür Portalı, [B3] MCID, [B4]); present-day state; toy style. Shape references: Doğancan's photos (never textures).

anchor.what: model origin = main dome centre (OSM w400562088 centroid), ground level

rotation_meaning: compass bearing of the model +X axis (model is in map axes: +X east, +Z south)
ground: y = 0 (flat); the map adds terrain height at the anchor only

heights_m.main dome: outer r 12.4 m (23.5 m [B2,B3] + shell), crown 44 m [§16 estimate: 43 m inside + ~1 m]; alem to ~48.5 m
heights_m.footprint: OSM outline r18055570 (hall ≈ 52 × 58 m between the corner minarets; DİA/KP 64 × 72 m incl. galleries)
heights_m.half-domes: r 12.2 m, crown ≈ 36.8 m; exedrae r 5 m, crown ≈ 27.8 m (yaklaşık)
heights_m.pier turrets: octagonal, to 37 m + small dome ≈ 39.6 m (OSM parts 30-39 m)
heights_m.minarets: hall corners 64 m [B3], 3 şerefe [B1]; courtyard pair 54 m (OSM) [doğrulanmadı], 2 şerefe [B1]; şerefe heights [doğrulanmadı]
heights_m.courtyard: walls 8.0 m (OSM 8 m), 30 portico domes from OSM parts (front ones larger), hexagonal şadırvan 6.3 m (yaklaşık)

parts: main dome + drum (28 windows, 8 buttress turrets)
courtyard (30 portico domes from OSM, şadırvan, gate)
footprint_note: map metres; map buildings under it are dropped
licence: model: Doğancan Işık project; no third-party models or textures; outline © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
